source.note: 1993-94 Fleer Basketball. Physical Series One (#1-240) and Series Two (#241-400) are combined into one collector-facing 400-card VCS Base ProductSet with equal base availability. Standard wax used 15-card packs and 36-pack boxes. Wax-only insert sets are modeled; cello-only, mail-in, promo, and non-pack Clyde Drexler cards #13-16 are excluded.

decisions.canonicalPackFormat: Historical standard wax configuration: 15 cards per pack, 36 packs per box.
decisions.seriesCombination: Combine physical Series One (#1-240) and Series Two (#241-400) into one 400-card Base ProductSet. One Series One pack image may be used for the single VCS pack type.
decisions.baseAvailability: All 400 Base cards are equally available in VCS despite the historical series split so completion/prestige reflects one collector-facing base set.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: RC is appended only to the 59 Base card numbers returned by TCDB's rookie index. Source RC text is removed first to prevent duplication.
decisions.cleanPlayerNames: Player remains collector-facing only. TCDB metadata such as UER/ERR/COR/VAR, print-code notes, odds, redemption notes, serial-number notes, and other source annotations are excluded from Player. Intentional short checklist labels such as LL, AW, PV, and CL may remain.
decisions.waxInsertScope: Include All-Stars, Clyde Drexler Career Highlights #1-12, Clyde Drexler Career Highlights Autographs, NBA Internationals, First Year Phenoms, Living Legends, NBA Superstars, and Sharpshooters. Exclude Rookie Sensations and Tower of Power because TCDB identifies them as cello-only, and exclude mail-in/promo issues.
decisions.clydeCareerHighlightsScope: Only #1-12 were normal pack pulls and are included. #13-15 were wrapper mail-in cards and #16 was distributed through NBA Inside Stuff, so #13-16 are excluded from VCS wax gameplay.
decisions.seriesSpecificOdds: Where TCDB publishes wax odds, retain those historical rates on the corresponding ProductSet even though VCS combines both physical series into one product.
decisions.unverifiedSeriesTwoCommonOdds: TCDB confirms NBA Superstars and Sharpshooters were issued in Series Two wax packs but does not publish numeric pack odds for either. Their ProductSets are included with oddsPerPack null rather than inventing rates. They are therefore intentionally non-pullable until defensible numeric odds are supplied.
decisions.redemptionExclusion: The 1993 NBA Draft Lottery Set Redemption card is a pack-related redemption mechanism but TCDB does not provide a numeric insertion rate. It is excluded from this wax model rather than adding an unreachable or invented-odds ProductSet.
decisions.releaseSafety: Product remains unreleased. Release should remain blocked until images/pricing are reviewed and numeric odds for NBA Superstars and Sharpshooters are resolved if those sets are expected to be pullable.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Complete #1-400 Base checklist combining physical Series One #1-240 and Series Two #241-400 with equal VCS availability.

productSets.name: Clyde Drexler Career Highlights
productSets.notes: Pack-issued portion only: #1-12 at 1:6 Series One packs. Cards #13-16 were non-pack distributions and are excluded.

productSets.name: NBA Superstars
productSets.notes: Confirmed issued in Series Two wax packs; numeric wax insertion rate not verified, so odds remain null rather than invented.

productSets.name: Sharpshooters
productSets.notes: Confirmed issued in Series Two wax packs; numeric wax insertion rate not verified, so odds remain null rather than invented.
